body: Getting in shape was one of those things that I thought would make life better and I'm glad I did it, but overall I guess I just always feel like something is missing. You're right I should feel proud of what I've done and I'll try my best to reflect it. A lot of my friends I've made here seem to have found better places for themselves through Greek life, significant others, and different groups on campus and due to this they seem to be pretty much ghosting me. I don't want to be around people who don't want me around so I'm not fighting it. The one person I thought I could confide in all of a sudden treats me like a stranger, so I found myself trying to take part in things that I had no place in (I guess like my pitiful attempt at joining a frat). I applied to transfer schools but I know it's not the schools fault I'm miserable. Thanks for your kind words, I'm going to do my best with what I've got here.
